governing_plan: TP51-A01 revision 2026-10-11.1 sections 1-6 (Cycle #51 Attempt #1); TECHNICAL_PLAN_TP51_A01.md sha256 c3ab08dbdba344b1acd25425d2f958efcab2652876a12cb71d909b1acc979314
purpose: One immutable, explicitly selected JSON capsule that makes the single retained ESPN college-football scoreboard observation of 2026-10-11 usable through the existing bas-source-time-query console and module (--prospective-evidence): its exact 25 provider event keys for 2026-10-17 and 50 participant overall records, each derived from its own raw fields, with the real observation bound of the retained request. A provider claim only: not an official NCAA result, independent corroboration, first-publication proof, PIT admission, forecast input admission or national coverage.

source.provider: ESPN site API college-football scoreboard (provider claim; manager-retained original data)
source.retention: Exact bytes retained by the Codex manager on 2026-10-11 (Cycle 51 preparation inputs); SOURCE_ACQUISITION ceiling 0: no browser/API request, archive resume, proxy, secret, paid call or prospective acquirer invocation by the worker.
source.odds_provider_object: The response's top-level 'provider' object names the odds provider (DraftKings). It is recorded only as ODDS_PROVIDER_OBJECT_NOT_SCOREBOARD_PROVENANCE; the provenance is the actual ESPN endpoint and retained receipt.

membership.authority: manager-frozen EXPECTED_COHORT (independent of worker output); the raw response's derived membership must equal it exactly, with multiplicities
membership.completeness: UNKNOWN: 25 events and the requested limit=1000 do not prove national completeness; no additional pages are assigned; all national historical/current FBS/FCS, transitions, era equivalents and outside opponents remain in the existing queue; not a representative evaluation sample

capsule.serialization: json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) encoded UTF-8 (no byte-order mark) followed by one LF; every governed value is compared by these canonical bytes (integer, float and boolean types differ)
capsule.layout: canonical/prospective_provider_observation_20261011/sha256/<capsule identity>/ holds capsule.json and the four byte-identical bundle members; manifests/prospective_provider_observation_20261011/sha256/<capsule identity>/run_manifest.json records the build; the reader needs only the capsule directory (portable; a rehoused genuine bundle serves identically)

identity.rule: capsule identity = sha256 of the canonical bytes of the identity document; the capsule directory is named by it; no other member

capsule.build: create-only: staged under canonical/.../.staging/, every member written and re-read, then one directory rename to sha256/<identity>; an existing identity directory must be byte-identical (ALREADY_PRESENT_IDENTICAL) or the build refuses; an interrupted build leaves no directory at the identity path and a resumed build yields identical bytes; processing order and read chunk size never change the bytes

event_rules.key: espn:event:<id> from the event's own 'id' (digits); an invalid id refuses the capsule
event_rules.competition: exactly one competition object is supported; otherwise COMPETITION_COUNT_NOT_ONE and no role or competition field is served
event_rules.season: season_year and season_type are the event's own integer season.year and season.type (booleans are not integers); otherwise null with SEASON_YEAR_INVALID / SEASON_TYPE_INVALID
event_rules.schedule: scheduled_utc is served only when the event and competition dates are both strict UTC 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]Z' instants, equal, and competition.timeValid is true; otherwise null with SCHEDULED_TIME_NO_VALID_ZONE, EVENT_COMPETITION_DATE_CONTRADICTION, TIME_VALID_MISSING or SCHEDULED_TIME_NOT_VALID_PER_SOURCE; the literals are preserved; no kickoff is invented
event_rules.status: event and competition status (type.name, type.state, type.completed) are both exposed; a difference is EVENT_COMPETITION_STATUS_CONTRADICTION; a missing status is STATUS_MISSING
event_rules.roles: home and away come from the competitors' homeAway values: exactly one 'home' and one 'away' among exactly two competitors, each with a valid id; otherwise ROLE_*_MISSING / ROLE_*_DUPLICATE / ROLE_*_ID_INVALID / ROLE_VALUE_INVALID / COMPETITOR_COUNT_NOT_TWO and both role blocks are null; no role is selected silently
event_rules.support: support_state is SUPPORTED exactly when unsupported_reasons is empty

participant_rules.key: espn:team:<id> from the competitor's own 'id' (digits); a team.id that differs is TEAM_ID_DISAGREEMENT (unsupported); an invalid competitor id is PARTICIPANT_ID_INVALID
participant_rules.side: the competitor's homeAway literal; a value other than home/away is SIDE_INVALID
participant_rules.name: team.displayName; missing is SOURCE_NAME_MISSING
participant_rules.record: the competitor's own records row whose name is exactly 'overall' and type exactly 'total'. Zero rows: RECORD_OVERALL_TOTAL_MISSING; more than one: RECORD_OVERALL_TOTAL_MULTIPLE (none selected, every candidate pointer kept). The literal summary is preserved. A strict two-integer 'W-L' string (ASCII digits, no sign, no leading zero) declares ties 0 by rule (TWO_INTEGER_FORM_TIES_ZERO_BY_RULE); a strict three-integer 'W-L-T' string supplies ties (THREE_INTEGER_FORM_TIES_STATED); anything else is RECORD_SUMMARY_MALFORMED (counts null); a missing summary is RECORD_SUMMARY_MISSING. Home/Away/conference records, substring matches, floats, negative numbers and fabricated zero records are never used
participant_rules.unconsumed: score placeholders, odds, ranks, statistics, leaders, venue, neutral site, broadcasts, future outcomes and every other unassigned raw field are not consumed

query_rules.selection: only with --prospective-evidence <capsule.json>; combining it with --database, --archive-evidence, --expect-archive-identity or --expect-contract is PROSPECTIVE_MODE_CONFLICT; the historical filters are FILTER_NOT_APPLICABLE; the prospective grains or --event without the capsule are PROSPECTIVE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED; --require-pit is PIT_ADMISSION_AUTHORITY_ABSENT
query_rules.cutoff: required, an ISO-8601 instant with an explicit zone; compared as exact instants (equivalent offsets equal): before the retained request start UNAVAILABLE_BEFORE_REQUEST_START, from the start up to but excluding the end INDETERMINATE_WITHIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL, at or after the end AVAILABLE_AT_OR_AFTER_REQUEST_END; a later cutoff never refreshes the snapshot; the current clock is never read
query_rules.filters: --season (2026 serves; any other integer is NOT_YET_AUDITED with no rows), --event espn:event:<digits>, --team espn:team:<digits> (exact; an unknown valid key serves no rows; a malformed key refuses); combined filters are conjunctive on both grains
query_rules.paging: --limit (default 50), --offset and --all; exact totals and next_offset; negative paging refuses
query_rules.labels: every served row carries the labels, the observation interval and the source body hash
query_rules.locations: accepted literal-location rules: local relative, long and extended-length Windows paths; network and device paths are refused before any access; a missing file is never created

consumer.defaults: every existing invocation, default view and accepted data identity is unchanged

non_claims: no source acquisition, archive resume, retry, proxy, paid call or scheduler
no forecast, model, training, scoring, betting/market feature or protected evaluation
no PIT admission, default activation, hold release or cross-provider identity promotion
equal numeric IDs or similar names do not authorize NCAA/CFBD joins
not an official NCAA result, corroboration or proof of first publication
no national completeness or representative-sample claim; historical F1 stays unmet
